Preventing the Worst
Eric S. Edelman and Franklin C. Miller

Reports of the death of nuclear deterrence are greatly exaggerated. Obituaries for nuclear weapons simply misapprehend the role these arms have played since 1945.In “The Strange Defeat of Nuclear Deterrence” (July/August 2026), Rose Gottemoeller insists that nuclear weapons increasingly lack value and purpose.
